title: Separate necessary from sufficient conditions — apply
topic: Testing sufficiency with a concrete integer

messages.content: A proposed test says any positive even integer is divisible by six. Apply the meanings of even and divisible by six to the number 10.
Which part of your account are you least certain about?
Passing that test is sufficient, so 10 must also pass divisibility by six without a separate check.
